sloka: अर्घ्यम् च प्रददौ तस्मै न्यायतः सुसमाहितः ।वव्रे प्रसादम् विप्रेइन्द्रात् मा विप्रम् मन्युः आविशेत् ॥१-१०-३१॥
transliteration: arghyam ca pradadau tasmai nyāyataḥ susamāhitaḥ ।vavre prasādam vipreindrāt mā vipram manyuḥ āviśet ॥1-10-31॥

translations.english: The king entered the inner apartment, duly offered him his daughter Shanta in marriage and experienced peace and satisfaction. Thus he (Rsyasringa) lived there, with all his desires fulfilled" (said Sumantra). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे दशमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the tenth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
